author: Mike Kasberg
newDesign: Five-part Thales theorem kit. Original semicircular board with seven apex bolt holes, two longitudinal-slot arms, one right-pivot layer spacer and a source-fit socketed stand. Three external M3 bolts/nuts required. Source art not copied; original sheet/carrier/joint reconstruction. Not a continuous retained linkage. No copied raw reference STL.
evidence: Actual STL downloaded, SHA verified, binary parsed and cross-sections inspected before implementation; reference-measurements.json and evidence/reference-sections.png. 27 source edge-adjacent components; source defects not silently repaired.
